description: This Java interface defines a Spring Data JPA repository for accessing reporting data from PostgreSQL views. It includes methods with native SQL queries to fetch project overview and fund utilization data, with optional filtering parameters.

classes.name: ReportRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for reporting database views, allowing querying of project overview and fund utilization data from PostgreSQL views.

methods.name: getProjectOverview
methods.description: Fetches a list of project overview entries filtered optionally by district and status. Returns raw data as List<Map<String, Object>> to facilitate CSV streaming.

methods.name: getFundUtilization
methods.description: Fetches fund utilization data filtered optionally by project code, returning raw data as List<Map<String, Object>>.
